constraints.action: publicly abandon 'peaceful reunification' framing on Taiwan
constraints.source: official rhetoric remains 'peaceful reunification is our consistent policy' even as PLA activity has shifted from episodic political signaling to sustained, continuous military presence
constraints.breaks_under: already effectively broken in substance (see stated_vs_revealed below); the performative framing persists because it costs nothing to maintain rhetorically while military facts on the ground change

stated_vs_revealed.stated: 'Peaceful reunification is our consistent policy' — Taiwan policy is framed as patient and non-coercive.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: PLA aircraft conducted 3,764 ADIZ incursions in 2025, up 22.4% from 2024's already-record year (monthly average up 129% from the Jan 2022-Apr 2024 baseline); two large-scale exercises in 2025 (Strait Thunder-2025A, Justice Mission 2025) plus December 2025 drills simulating island encirclement mark a shift from politically-triggered episodes to sustained continuous military pressure. A Nov 2025 US congressional commission (USCC) assessed PLA could blockade Taiwan 'in a matter of hours' with little advance warning.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The rhetorical frame has not moved in a decade; the military posture underneath it has moved from occasional signaling to a standing capability for rapid coercive action. This is the largest and most consequential stated-vs-revealed gap in the dataset for the taiwan_semiconductor theatre.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Oct 9 2025 rare-earth and critical-mineral export controls (6 MOFCOM proclamations, extraterritorial reach to any product globally containing Chinese-origin rare earth content) were framed as routine national-security/non-proliferation administration.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The controls were suspended for one year within roughly a month, in November 2025, immediately following a US-China trade agreement — timed to the negotiating calendar, not to any change in the underlying proliferation rationale.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Export controls on the system's tightest physical chokepoint (rare-earth refining) function as a deployable-and-retractable bargaining lever on a diplomatic clock, not a fixed regulatory posture. This sets a clean tripwire: watch the Nov 2026 truce-expiry date.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: 'Common prosperity' and comprehensive stabilization of the property market and local-government debt.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The 2024-2028 program swaps/re-terms hidden local debt (14.3tn yuan to 2.3tn yuan by 2028 via bond issuance) rather than writing it down or transferring resources to households; 2026 policy explicitly favors inventory-absorption and risk containment over renewed debt-fueled stimulus; growth estimates have been marked down to ~4.1% for 2026.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Priority ordering reveals systemic-solvency management (protecting local-government and bank balance sheets) over household consumption relief, despite the 'common prosperity' framing implying the reverse.

tripwires.if: the Nov 2025 one-year rare-earth export-control truce lapses (~Oct-Nov 2026) without a renewed US-China deal
tripwires.then: expect reinstatement of the Oct 9 2025 extraterritorial rules as the default leverage move, given the demonstrated deploy-and-retract pattern

tripwires.if: US tightens semiconductor export controls further (e.g., closes the H20/H200 revenue-share channel)
tripwires.then: China re-escalates critical-mineral controls ahead of any scheduled truce expiry, since the two tracks have moved in lockstep in 2025

tripwires.if: a regional bank failure or visible property-sector bank run occurs
tripwires.then: Beijing abandons the stated 'risk containment, no debt-fueled stimulus' posture and monetizes/bails out within a single Politburo meeting cycle (weeks, not quarters)

what_would_change_my_mind: Politburo Standing Committee and PLA leadership decision-making is opaque by design; nothing here is sourced to internal deliberation, only to observable outputs (military activity counts, MOFCOM proclamations, budget documents). Confidence on trade/military behavior is medium-high because flow and document data are rich; confidence on succession politics and factional dynamics inside the CCP is low — I found no reliable open-source basis for modeling internal splits and did not attempt to invent one. A leadership transition signal (unusual absence, purge announcement beyond the already-reported 2026 general purge, or a Central Committee plenum with unscheduled personnel changes) would be the thing to watch.
